results.q: What is the difference between moral responsibility and legal resnposibility. Give example.
results.answer: Moral responsibility tends to be shared among many individuals, whereas causal, role, and legal responsibilities tend to be exclusive [1]. Moral responsibility focuses on what individuals should do in the future rather than assigning blame for a past event [1]. In contrast, legal responsibility means an individual or organization can be charged with a crime or liable for damages in a civil lawsuit [3]. An example of legal responsibility is strict liability, where a manufacturer can be found liable for damages if a product injures someone, even if the product met all safety standards and the manufacturer did nothing wrong [3]. Another example involves the Therac-25 case, where AECL could have been sued for the accidents caused by their cancer radiation treatment machine [3] and [5].
